messages:
Nadine: spotting a weird reflow when users toggle unit grouping on the infra dashboard. legend jumps from two-line layout to a stacked block and overlaps the timepicker. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/reflow-issue.png
Kofi: repro'd it. happens when mixed units exist (ms + req/s + percent) and the panel width is ~820px. the legend's width calculation uses full label length, not compacted pill width.
Ria: quick proposal: introduce a "priority pin" for up to 3 series. pinned items always surface to the top of the legend, rest collapse into "More (n)". this avoids rank-flip surprises when smoothing changes ordering.
Ethan: love priority pin. accessibility note: pinned state must be conveyed via aria-pressed and have an accessible name, e.g., "Pinned: database-read-latency".
Nadine: aside: unit grouping strip could render small, labeled bands inside the legend to visually cluster series by unit (thin divider + label). keeps axis labels consistent.
Kofi: technical: legend currently calculates width with text-measure on hidden elements; switch to measuring pill widths and clamp with CSS flex-basis to prevent overflow. CSS example: ```css
.legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
.legend .item { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 72px; max-width: 240px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
```
Ria: smoothing/attenuation UX: add a quick control in each legend item menu: "Attenuation: none / soft / strong". default global = none. soft -> markers 0.6 opacity, r=4px; strong -> 0.4 opacity, r=2px.
Ethan: add microcopy for attenuation tooltip: "Temporarily reduce marker prominence to focus on trend. Per-series setting overrides dashboard default." keep under 120 chars.
Nadine: keyboard flow: when panel is focused, pressing P should toggle pin on the focused legend item, M expands/collapses More group, A opens attenuation menu. ensure SR announces changes via aria-live.
Kofi: backend change: add fields spikeFlag (boolean), rawValue and smoothedValue (strings) and allow a priorityHint int for candidate pins. payload sample: "spikeFlag": "true", "rawValue": "1280", "smoothedValue": "1024", "priorityHint": "5".
Ria: copy tweak for collapsed group: "Other (8) — showing low activity series" -> shorter: "Other (8) — low activity". Also show expand shortcut: "Press M to expand" in tooltip.
Ethan: accessibility checklist: 1) legend container focusable 2) pinned items announced 3) collapsed count announced with expand shortcut 4) attenuation/menu uses aria-menu semantics 5) unit chips include aria-label with full unit name.
Nadine: action items: Kofi -> change width calc + API fields; Ria -> mock priority pin + attenuation menu states and update microcopy; Ethan -> a11y spec and keyboard mapping; I'll schedule a 20m sync Fri.
